- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for 3–5 day horizons.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes — add 3–7% to forecast if sentiment drops below -0.40 within last 3 days.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak of last 5-day range for 10–15 day horizons.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast > 10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 2–5% for 15–30 day horizons.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was positive 3–5 days ago, forecast should be 2–4% lower than model output to account for delayed market reaction.
- Avoid overconfidence in short-term spikes — if forecast rises > 5% from prior day with sentiment > 0.20, reduce by 1–3% for next 3 days.
